decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted HH/04 (received 02/01/2013), Location plan, Existing Site Layout (received 23/01/2013), Proposed site plan (received24/01/2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  west wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Demolition of garages and erection of a single storey rear extension to depot office building.
